40002808.author: पदार्थः
40002808.content: सा पापा that evil woman, पुत्रशोकार्दितम् tortured with grief on account of his son, विसंज्ञम् having lost senses, भुवि on the floor, पतितम् had fallen, विवेष्टमानम् writhing, ऐक्ष्वाकम्  (Dasaratha) born in the Ikshvaku race, इदम् this word, अब्रवीत् said.

40002808.author: Translation
40002808.content: The evil woman (Kaikeyi) said to the king of the Ikshvaku race who lay unconscious on the floor writhing and tormented with grief on account of his son.

40002809.author: पदार्थः
40002809.content: मम me (what you have done for me), संश्रवम् the promise, संश्रुत्य having promised, पापं कृत्वा इव as if you have committed a sin done a sinful act, सन्नः a dejected man, क्षितितले on the ground (floor), शेषे lying down, इदम् this, किम् what, त्वम् you, स्थित्याम् status, स्थातुम् to remain,  अर्हसि you are worthy of.

40002809.author: Translation
40002809.content: (Kaikeyi said) What is this? After hearing my response to the promised boon, why are you lying down on the floor dejected as if you had committed a sin? It behoves you to maintain your status.

40002810.author: पदार्थः
40002810.content: धर्मविदः conversant with righteousness, जनाः people, सत्यम् truth, परमं धर्मम् is a great virtue, आहुः हि are saying, मया च by me also, सत्यम् truth, आश्रित्य by following, त्वम् you, धर्मम् about your duty, प्रबोधितः enlightened with.

40002810.author: Translation
40002810.content: Those conversant with righteousness say that truth is a great virtue. By following the truth, I have enlightened you about your duty.

40002811.author: पदार्थः
40002811.content: राजन् O king, जगतीपतिः lord of the earth, शैब्यः Saibya, श्येनाय पक्षिणे to a hawk, a bird, स्वाम् his own, तनुम् body, संश्रुत्य having promised, उत्तमाम् highest, गतिम् state, जगाम attained.

40002811.author: Translation
40002811.content: O King O lord of the earth (king) Saibya attained the highest state by offering his own body to a hawk in accordance with his promise.

40002812.author: पदार्थः
40002812.content: तथा In the same way, तेजस्वी lustrous, अलर्कः (king) Alarka, वेदपारगे to an adept in the Vedas, याचमाने soliciting, ब्राह्मणे (to) the brahmin, स्वके his own, नेत्रे eyes, उद्धृत्य havng plucked, अविमनाः without hesitation, ददौ हि gave it indeed.

40002812.author: Translation
40002812.content: In the same way the lustrous king Alarka, on being solicited by a brahmin who was an adept in the Vedas, plucked his own eyes and gave them to him without hesitation.

40002813.author: पदार्थः
40002813.content: सरितां पतिः तु as regards the lord of rivers (ocean), सत्यम् अन्वित: who follows the truth, स्वल्पाम् very little, मर्यादाम् as boundary, स्वाम् his own, वेलाम् shore, समये when time comes, सत्यानुरोधात् in obedience to truth, नातिवर्तते does not trangress.

40002813.author: Translation
40002813.content: The ocean, lord of rivers, even when (tidal) time comes does not cross the shore in obedience to truth.

40002814.author: पदार्थः
40002814.content: सत्यम् truth, एकपदम् in the form of one word, ब्रह्म Brahman, सत्ये on truth, धर्मः righteousness, प्रतिष्ठितः is established firmly, सत्यमेव truth alone, अक्षयाः is imperishable, वेदाः Vedas, सत्यमेव by truth alone, परम् supreme state, आप्यते will be attained.

40002814.author: Translation
40002814.content: Truth is Brahman in one word. Righteousness is firmly established in truth. Truth is the imperishable Vedas. The supreme state can be attained by means of truth.

40002815.author: पदार्थः
40002815.content: सत्तम O excellent one, मतिः your mind, धर्मे in righteousness, धृता यदि if fixed firmly, सत्यम् truth, समनुवर्तस्व follow it , मे my, वरः boon, सफलः अस्तु may be fulfilled, वरदः असि हि you are the bestower of boons indeed.

40002815.author: Translation
40002815.content: O excellent one, if your mind is firmly fixed in righteousness, then by following it fulfil the boon granted to me.You are the bestower of boons indeed

40002816.author: पदार्थः
40002816.content: इह in this matter, धर्मस्य of righteousness, अभिकामार्थम् fulfilling for the sake of, मम my, अभिचोदनाच्च urging you, सुतम् son, रामम् Rama, प्रव्राजय be exiled, त्वाम् to you, त्रिः thrice, अहम् I, अब्रवीमि am telling you.

40002816.author: Translation
40002816.content: You must uphold righteousness. I also urge you to do that. Send your son Rama to the forest. I am repeating this statememt thrice.

40002817.author: पदार्थः
40002817.content: आर्य O noble one, त्वम् you, मम my, इमम् this, समयम् agreement, न करिष्यसि यदि if you do  not fulfil, परित्यक्ता abandoned (by you), ते अग्रतः in your presence, जीवितम् my life, परित्यक्ष्यामि will discard.

40002817.author: Translation
40002817.content: O noble one, if you do not fulfil the agreement, it will mean I have been abandoned by you. (Therefore) I will give up my life in your presence.

40002818.author: पदार्थः
40002818.content: निर्विशङ्कया without fear or hesitation, कैकेय्या by Kaikeyi, एवम् in this way, प्रचोदितः having been urged, राजा king, बलिः emperor Bali, इन्द्रकृतं यथा like the one employed by Indra (through Vamana), पाशम् noose (promise), मोक्तुम् to release, नाशकत् was not able.

40002818.author: Translation
40002818.content: In this way urged by Kaikeyi without fear or hesitation, he (Dasaratha), like Bali unable to release himself from the noose cast by Indra (through Vamana), could not get out of the noose of promise.

40002819.author: पदार्थः
40002819.content: सः Dasaratha, युगचक्रान्तरम् between the wheels and the yoke, परिस्पन्दन् restlessly moving, धुर्यः यथा like a beast of burden (bullock), उद्भ्रान्तहृदयः with heart beating wildly, विवर्णवदनः चापि  with a pale face too, अभवत् remained.

40002819.author: Translation
40002819.content: Like a bullock, restlessly moving between the wheels and the yoke, Dasaratha's heart started beating wildly and his face turned pale.

40002820.author: पदार्थः
40002820.content: भूपतिः king, विह्वलाभ्याम् नेत्राभ्याम् eyes overwhelmed (with fears), अपश्यन्निव as if unable to see, कृच्छ्रात् with great difficulty, धैर्येण with courage, संस्तभ्य gaining a firm footing, कैकेयीम् to Kaikeyi, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् said.

40002820.author: Translation
40002820.content: The king was unable to see with his eyes overwhelmed (with tears). Gaining with great difficulty a firm footing and courage he addressed Kaikeyi:

40002821.author: पदार्थः
40002821.content: पापे O wicked woman, अग्नौ at the sacred fire, मन्त्रकृतः amid chantings of mantras, ते your, यः पाणिः which hand, मया by me, धृतः was held, तम् that one, स्वजम् begotten by me, तव पुत्रं चैव your son also, त्वया सह along with you, त्यजामि disown.

40002821.author: Translation
40002821.content: O wicked woman, I held your hand amid chantings of mantras with the sacred fire (as witness). I now disown that hand, you and your son begotten by me.

40002822.author: पदार्थः
40002822.content: देवि O queen, रजनी night, सूर्यस्य of the Sun, उदयनं प्रति about to rise, प्रयाता departed,  अभिषेकम् consecration, गुरुजनः preceptors, माम् me, ध्रुवम् definitely, त्वरयिष्यति will hurry me

40002822.author: Translation
40002822.content: O queen the night has departed and the Sun is about to rise. The preceptors now will definitely ask me to hasten for the consecration.

40002823.author: पदार्थः
40002823.content: तदर्थम् for that purpose, उपकल्पितैः arranged, रामाभिषेकसम्भारैः all preparations for Rama's consecration, मृतस्य of the dead, मे to me, रामः Rama, सलिलक्रियाम् the funeal rites it offering water to the dead, कारयितव्यः should be done.

40002823.author: Translation
40002823.content: With the materials already collected for the consecration of Rama he will perform my funeral rite of offering water to the dead.

40002824.author: पदार्थः
40002824.content: अशुभाचारे O woman of inauspicious practices, रामाभिषेचनम् Rama's consecration, व्याहन्तासि यदि if you prevent, सपुत्रया along with your son, त्वया by you, सलिलक्रिया offering water to the dead, नैवकर्तव्या should not be done.

40002824.author: Translation
40002824.content: O woman of inauspicious practices, since you are obstructing Rama's coronation, you and your son shall not perform my funeral rite of offering water to the dead.

40002825.author: पदार्थः
40002825.content: पूर्वम् formerly, तथासुखम् enjoying such happiness, जनम् people, दृष्ट्वा having seen, पुनः again, हतहर्षम् bereft of cheerfulness, निरानन्दम् devoid of happiness, अवाङ्मुखम् with downcast faces, द्रष्टुम् to see, अहम् I, न शक्नोमि च not able.

40002825.author: Translation
40002825.content: Having seen people formerly enjoying happiness, I cannot see them again with their downcast, cheerless faces devoid of all happiness.

40002826.author: पदार्थः
40002826.content: महात्मनः highsouled, तस्य भूमिपस्य for that king, ताम् to her, तथा in that way, ब्रुवतः while speaking, चन्द्रनक्षत्रशालिनी resplendent with the Moon and the stars, पुण्या holy, शर्वरी night, प्रभाता dawned.

40002826.author: Translation
40002826.content: While the king was thus speaking to her (Kaikeyi) that holy night resplendent with the Moon and the stars, the day dawned.

40002827.author: पदार्थः
40002827.content: ततः after that, पापसमाचारा of sinful conduct, वाक्यज्ञा skilful in words, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, रोषमूर्छिता rendered senseless by wrath, पुनः again, पार्थिवम् to the king, परुषम् in harsh, वाक्यम् words, उवाच said.

40002827.author: Translation
40002827.content: Thereafter, Kaikeyi of sinful conduct and skilful in the use of words, rendered senseless by wrath, again addressing the king in harsh words said:

40002828.author: पदार्थः
40002828.content: राजन् O king, गररुजोपमम् comparable to the pain of venom, वाक्यम् words, भाषसे are you  speaking?, इदं किम् what is this?, अक्लिष्टम् one who is not pained, पुत्रम् son, रामम् Rama, इह here, आनाययितुम् to bring, अर्हसि behoves you.

40002828.author: Translation
40002828.content: O king, why are you speaking these painful, poisonous words? What is this? It behoves you to summon your son Rama who does not expearience this pain.

40002829.author: पदार्थः
40002829.content: मम सुतम् my son, राज्ये in the kingdom, स्थाप्य having installed, रामम् Rama, वनेचरम् a forestor, कृत्वा having made, माम् me, निःसपत्नाम् devoid of rivals, कृत्वा having made, कृतकृत्यः भविष्यसि you will have fulfilled your duty.

40002829.author: Translation
40002829.content: Only after you have  installed my son in the kingdom and sent Rama to the forest and  made me free from rivals, you shall have your duty fulfiled.

40002830.author: पदार्थः
40002830.content: सः राजा that king (Dasaratha), तीक्ष्णेन with a sharp, प्रतोदेन by the lash, नुन्नः beaten up, हयोत्तमः इव like a horses of the best breed, अभीक्ष्णम् exceedingly, प्रचोदितः incited, कैकेयीम् to Kaikeyi, इदम् this word, अब्रवीत् said.

40002830.author: Translation
40002830.content: The king who was very much incited by her words, like a horse of the best breed whipped by the lash, replied to Kaikeyi:

40002831.author: पदार्थः
40002831.content: धर्मबन्धेन by bond of righteousness, बद्धः अस्मि I am bound, मम चेतना च my intellect, नष्टा  is destroyed, धार्मिकम् virtuous, ज्येष्ठम् eldest, प्रियम् beloved, पुत्रम् son, रामम् Rama, द्रष्टुम् to see, इच्छामि wish.

40002831.author: Translation
40002831.content: I am bound by bond of righteousness. My intellect is destroyed. I wish to see my beloved, virtuous firstborn, Rama.

40002832.author: पदार्थः
40002832.content: ततः then, प्रभाताम् at dawn, रजनीम् the night (gone by), दिवाकरे the Sun, उदिते having arisen, पुण्ये sacred, नक्षत्रयोगे च in favourable conjunction with the star, मुहूर्ते in auspicious time (for coronation), समाहिते having arrived, तदा then, गुणसम्पन्नः virtuous, वसिष्ठः Vasistha शिष्यैः with disciples, परिवृतः surrounded by, सम्भारान् articles (for the ceremony), उपगृह्य having collected, आशु quickly, पुरोत्तमम् best of (the palace), प्रविवेश entered.

40002832.author: Translation
40002832.content: The night dawned. Ths Sun rose. The auspicious time with the sacred star in (favourable) conjunction arrived. The virtuous Vasistha, surrounded by his disciples, soon entered the best of abodes with the articles collected (for the ceremony).

40002833.author: पदार्थः
40002833.content: ततः then, प्रभाताम् at dawn, रजनीम् the night (gone by), दिवाकरे the Sun, उदिते having arisen, पुण्ये sacred, नक्षत्रयोगे च in favourable conjunction with the star, मुहूर्ते in auspicious time (for coronation), समाहिते having arrived, तदा then, गुणसम्पन्नः virtuous, वसिष्ठः Vasistha शिष्यैः with disciples, परिवृतः surrounded by, सम्भारान् articles (for the ceremony), उपगृह्य having collected, आशु quickly, पुरोत्तमम् best of (the palace), प्रविवेश entered.

40002833.content: The night dawned. Ths Sun rose. The auspicious time with the sacred star in (favourable) conjunction arrived. The virtuous Vasistha, surrounded by his disciples, soon entered the best of abodes with the articles collected (for the ceremony).

40002834.author: पदार्थः
40002834.content: सिक्तसम्मार्जितपथाम् streets swept and sprinkled with water, पताकोत्तमभूषिताम् decorated with excellent flags, विचित्रकुसुमाकीर्णाम् strewn with flowers of variegated colours,  नानास्रग्भि: with various flower garlands, विराजिताम् shining with, संहृष्टमनुजोपेताम् filled with people who were rejoicing, समृद्धविपणापणाम् stalls and markets abundantly filled with merchandise, महोत्सवसमाकीर्णाम् full of great festivities, राघवार्थे for the sake of the scion of the Raghus (Rama), समुत्सुकाम् curious, सर्वतः everywhere, चन्दनागुरुधूपैः with sandal, and incense, प्रतिधूपिताम् made fragrant, पुरन्दरपुरोपमाम् resembling Amaravati, the abode of Indra, तां पुरीम् that city, समतिक्रम्य having covered some distance (by walk ), नानाद्विजगणायुतम् with many brahmins, पौरजानपदाकीर्णम् thronged with citizens and villagers, ब्राह्मणैः with brahmins, उपशोभितम् graced by, यज्ञविद्भिः conversant with sacrificial rituals, सदस्यैः with priests, परमद्विजैः with eminent brahmins, सम्पूर्णम् filled with, अन्तःपुरश्रेष्ठम् the best of inner apartments, ददर्श beheld.

40002834.author: Translation
40002834.content: The streets in Ayodhya were swept and sprinkled with water, decorated with excellent flags, strewn with flowers of variegated colours and bedecked with various flower garlands. The streets were crowded with curious people rejoicing at the event. The stalls and markets were abundantly filled with merchandise.The city was full of great festivities. The people were curious to see Rama. Sandalwood and incense were burnt and fragrance pervaded in all the directions. The city resembled Amaravati, the abode of Indra. Vasistha entered the city, covered some distance and beheld the best inner apartment. There he saw host of brahmins, citizens and villagers. The best of inner apartments was graced with brahmins who were experts in sacrificial rituals priests and eminent  brahmins.

40002837.content: सिक्तसम्मार्जितपथाम् streets swept and sprinkled with water, पताकोत्तमभूषिताम् decorated with excellent flags, विचित्रकुसुमाकीर्णाम् strewn with flowers of variegated colours,  नानास्रग्भि: with various flower garlands, विराजिताम् shining with, संहृष्टमनुजोपेताम् filled with people who were rejoicing, समृद्धविपणापणाम् stalls and markets abundantly filled with merchandise, महोत्सवसमाकीर्णाम् full of great festivities, राघवार्थे for the sake of the scion of the Raghus (Rama), समुत्सुकाम् curious, सर्वतः everywhere, चन्दनागुरुधूपैः with sandal, and incense, प्रतिधूपिताम् made fragrant, पुरन्दरपुरोपमाम् resembling Amaravati, the abode of Indra, तां पुरीम् that city, समतिक्रम्य having covered some distance (by walk ), नानाद्विजगणायुतम् with many brahmins, पौरजानपदाकीर्णम् thronged with citizens and villagers, ब्राह्मणैः with brahmins, उपशोभितम् graced by, यज्ञविद्भिः conversant with sacrificial rituals, सदस्यैः with priests, परमद्विजैः with eminent brahmins, सम्पूर्णम् filled with, अन्तःपुरश्रेष्ठम् the best of inner apartments, ददर्श beheld.

40002837.author: Translation
40002837.content: The streets in Ayodhya were swept and sprinkled with water, decorated with excellent flags, strewn with flowers of variegated colours and bedecked with various flower garlands. The streets were crowded with curious people rejoicing at the event. The stalls and markets were abundantly filled with merchandise.The city was full of great festivities. The people were curious to see Rama. Sandalwood and incense were burnt and fragrance pervaded in all the directions. The city resembled Amaravati, the abode of Indra. Vasistha entered the city, covered some distance and beheld the best inner apartment. There he saw host of brahmins, citizens and villagers. The best of inner apartments was graced with brahmins who were experts in sacrificial rituals priests and eminent  brahmins.

40002838.author: पदार्थः
40002838.content: परमर्षिः an eminent ascetic, वसिष्ठः Vasistha, परमप्रीतः exceedingly delighted, तत् अन्तःपुरम् that inner apartment, आसाद्य having reached, तं जनम् those people, व्यतिचक्राम passed by, विवेश च also entered.

40002838.author: Translation
40002838.content: Having reached the inner apartment, the eminent ascetic, Vasistha felt very happy. He passed by the people and entered the inner apartment.

40002839.author: पदार्थः
40002839.content: सः तु as for him (Vasistha), मनुजसिंहस्य a lion among men (Dasaratha's), द्वारे at the entrance, विनिष्क्रान्तम् coming out, सचिवम् minister, प्रियदर्शनम् handsome, सुमन्त्रं नाम by name Sumantra, सारथिम् charioteer, अपश्यत् saw.

40002839.author: Translation
40002839.content: Sage Vasistha saw handsome Sumantra, minister to Dasaratha, a lion among the charioteers coming out of the gate.

40002840.author: पदार्थः
40002840.content: महातेजाः highly lustrous, वसिष्ठः Vasistha, विशारदम् expert, तं सूतपुत्रम् the son of the charioteer, Sumantra, उवाच (आह) said, माम् me, इह here, आगतम् arrival, नृपतेः to the king, क्षिप्रम् immediately, आचक्ष्व announce.

40002840.author: Translation
40002840.content: Effulgent Vasistha said to the expert chariotieer Sumantra to inform the king immediately of his arrival.

40002849.author: पदार्थः
40002849.content: अहनि day, समुदिते commences, (पुण्ये sacred), पुष्ये नक्षत्रयोगे च under conjunction of the Pushya star, रामः Rama, यथा in a way, राज्यम् kingdom, अवाप्नुयात् may obtain, in that way, महाराजम् maharaja (Dasaratha), त्वरयस्व hasten.

40002849.author: Translation
40002849.content: Hasten the maharaja as Rama has to be installed in the kingdom as soon as the day breaks under the conjunction of the sacred Pushya star.

40002850.author: पदार्थः
40002850.content: सूतपुत्रः charioteer Sumantra, तस्य महात्मनः of that great Vasistha, इति in this way, वचः words, श्रुत्वा having heard, नृपतिशार्दूलम् tiger among kings, स्तुवन् while praising, निवेशनम् palace, प्रविवेश entered.

40002850.author: Translation
40002850.content: Having heard the words of the great Vasistha, charioteer Sumantra entered the inner apartment, singing the praise of this tiger among kings (Dasaratha).

40002851.author: पदार्थः
40002851.content: द्वारस्था: doorkeepers, राज्ञः of the king, प्रियचिकीर्षवः beloved wellwishers, पूर्वोदितम् who had come earlier, वृद्धम् aged, राजसम्मतम् liked by the king, तं तु him, अभिसंरोद्धुम् to detain, न शेकुः were not able.

40002851.author: Translation
40002851.content: The doorkeepers, beloved wellwishers of the king, did not detain aged Sumantra  who was liked by the king and who had arrived early.

40002852.author: पदार्थः
40002852.content: सः he, राज्ञः of the king, समीपस्थः being near, ताम् that particular, अवस्थाम् state of mind, अजज्ञिवान् was unaware, परमतुष्टाभिः with highly pleasing, वाग्भि: words, अभिष्टोतुम् to praise, प्रचक्रमे commenced.

40002852.author: Translation
40002852.content: Sumantra approached the king unaware of the state of his mind and commenced praising him in highly pleasing words (as usual).

40002853.author: पदार्थः
40002853.content: ततः then, सूतः charioteer, सुमन्त्रः Sumantra, पार्थिवस्य king's, निवेशने in the apartment,  प्राञ्जलिः भूत्वा with folded hands, यथाकालम् appropriate to the time, जगतीपतिम् lord of the earth, तुष्टाव praised.

40002853.author: Translation
40002853.content: Thereafter the charioteer Sumantra entered the inner apartment of the king, and with folded hands began singing the praise of the lord of the earth appropriate to the hour.

40002854.author: पदार्थः
40002854.content: स्वतः inherently, आनन्दघनः full of delight, तेजस्वी mighty, सागरः ocean, भास्करोदये at sunrise, यथा just as that, नन्दति rejoices, तथा in that way, प्रीतेन pleased, मनसा mind, प्रीतः became delighted.

40002854.author: Translation
40002854.content: Just as the mighty ocean rejoices at sunrise, the inherently cheerful Sumantra became delighted to see the king.

40002855.author: पदार्थः
40002855.content: मातलिः charioteer, अस्यां वेलायाम् at this point of  time, इन्द्रम् Indra, अभितुष्टाव extoled, सः that Indra, सर्वान् all, दानवान् demons, अजयत् conquered, तथा in that way, अहम् I, त्वाम् you, बोधयामि awakening.

40002855.author: Translation
40002855.content: Just as Indra's charioteer at this time (at dawn) extols him, the conquerer of demons, so do I rouse you (with a song).

40002856.author: पदार्थः
40002856.content: सहाङ्गविद्याः together with the knowledge of Vedangas, वेदाः Vedas, आत्मभुवम् selfborn, विभुम् lord, ब्रह्माणम् Brahma, यथा as, बोधयन्ति awakening, तथा so, अहम् I, अद्य now, त्वाम् you, बोधयामि rousing.

40002856.author: Translation
40002856.content: Just as the Vedas and Vedangas awaken the selfborn lord Brahma, so do I  awaken you.

40002857.author: पदार्थः
40002857.content: सह चन्द्रेण along with the Moon, आदित्यः the Sun, भूतधराम् supporter of all beings, शुभाम् auspicious, पृथिवीम् earth, यथा how, बोधयति awakens, तथा in that manner, अहम् I, त्वाम् you, अद्यबोधयामि am awakening you today.

40002857.author: Translation
40002857.content: As the Sun along with the Moon awakens the auspicious earth which supports all  beings, in the same way I am awakening you today.

40002858.author: पदार्थः
40002858.content: महाराज O maharaja, कृतकौतुकमङ्गलः clad in auspicious robes befitting the festivity, वपुषा in body, विराजमानः shining, मेरोः mount Meru, दिवाकरः इव like the Sun, आशु immediately, उत्तिष्ठ get up.

40002858.author: Translation
40002858.content: O mighty king get up at once like the Sun rising up mount Meru. Put on your beautiful body auspicious robes befitting the festivity.

40002859.author: पदार्थः
40002859.content: काकुत्स्थ O descendant of Kakutstha, सोमसूर्यौ च moon and sun, शिववैश्रवणावपि Siva and Kubera, वरुणः च Varuna, अग्नि: Agni, इन्द्रः च Indra also, ते to you, विजयम् all victory,  प्रदिशन्तु bestow.

40002859.author: Translation
40002859.content: O descendent of Kakutstha, may Moon and Sun, Siva and Kubera, Varuna, Agni and Indra bestow victory on you.

40002860.author: पदार्थः
40002860.content: नृपशार्दूल a tiger among kings, भगवती holy, रात्रिः night, गता passed, तव your, इदम् this, कृतकृत्यम् tasks accomplished, बुद्ध्यस्व get enlightened, अनन्तरम् thereafter, कार्यम् installation ceremony, कुरु perform, रामस्य Rama's, समग्रम् cimplete, अभिषेचनम्  preparations for coronation, उदतिष्ठत are ready.

40002860.author: Translation
40002860.content: O best among kings the holy night has passed. Having been acquainted with the acts accomplished so far, perform whatever is further necessary for the installation    ceremony. All preparations for Rama's coronation ceremony have since been complete.

40002861.author: पदार्थः
40002861.content: नृपशार्दूल a tiger among kings, भगवती holy, रात्रिः night, गता passed, तव your, इदम् this, कृतकृत्यम् tasks accomplished, बुद्ध्यस्व get enlightened, अनन्तरम् thereafter, कार्यम् installation ceremony, कुरु perform, रामस्य Rama's, समग्रम् cimplete, अभिषेचनम्  preparations for coronation, उदतिष्ठत are ready.

40002861.author: Translation
40002861.content: O best among kings the holy night has passed. Having been acquainted with the acts accomplished so far, perform whatever is further necessary for the installation    ceremony. All preparations for Rama's coronation ceremony have since been complete.

40002862.author: पदार्थः
40002862.content: भगवान् venerable, वसिष्ठः Vasistha, पौरजनपदैश्चापि the inhabitants of town and country, नैगमैश्च by merchants, कृताञ्जलि: greeted with folded hands, ब्राह्मणैः सह along with brahmins, स्वयम् in person, तिष्ठति is waiting.

40002862.author: Translation
40002862.content: Venerable Vasistha along with inhabitants of the city and countryside including merchants and brahmins with folded hands awaits you.

40002863.author: पदार्थः
40002863.content: राजन् O king राघवस्य Rama's, अभिषेचनम् coronation, क्षिप्रम् promptly, आज्ञाप्यताम् be ordered, अपालाः without keeper, पशवः cattle, यथा as, अनायका without commander, सेना army, यथा as, चन्द्रं विना without moon, रात्रिः night, यथा as, वृषं विना without a bull, गावः cows, यथा as, यत्र where, राजा king, न दृश्यते is not seen, राष्ट्रम् kingdom, एवम् just like that, भविता हि will become.

40002863.author: Translation
40002863.content: O king Rama's installation may be promptly ordered. As herds without herdsman, army without commander, night without the Moon, and cows without a bull, so is a kingdom without a king.

40002864.author: पदार्थः
40002864.content: राजन् O king राघवस्य Rama's, अभिषेचनम् coronation, क्षिप्रम् promptly, आज्ञाप्यताम् be ordered, अपालाः without keeper, पशवः cattle, यथा as, अनायका without commander, सेना army, यथा as, चन्द्रं विना without moon, रात्रिः night, यथा as, वृषं विना without a bull, गावः cows, यथा as, यत्र where, राजा king, न दृश्यते is not seen, राष्ट्रम् kingdom, एवम् just like that, भविता हि will become.

40002864.author: Translation
40002864.content: O king Rama's installation may be promptly ordered. As herds without herdsman, army without commander, night without the Moon, and cows without a bull, so is a kingdom without a king.

40002865.author: पदार्थः
40002865.content: महीपतिः lord of the earth, इति in this way, सान्त्वपूर्वमिव as though in appealing tone, अर्थवत् meaningful, तस्य वचः his words, श्रुत्वा having heard, भूयः एव again, शोकेन in grief,  अभ्यकीर्यत was pervaded.

40002865.author: Translation
40002865.content: Hearing these  meaningful words of Sumantra uttered in an appealing tone, the lord of the earth relapsed into grief.

40002866.author: पदार्थः
40002866.content: धार्मिकः virtuous, श्रीमान् glorious, सः राजा that king, सुतं प्रति about his son, सन्नहर्षः  cheerless, शोकरक्तेक्षणः eyes red with tears, उद्वीक्ष्य looking upwards, तं सूतम् to that charioteer, उवाच said, वाक्यैः with words, मम my, मर्माणि vital parts of body, भूयः (एव) still more, निकृन्तसि are piercing (causing excessive pain).

40002866.author: Translation
40002866.content: The virtuous and glorious king thinking of his son without cheer looked upward with eyes red with tears and said to the charioteer, You are causing my heart excruciating pain with your words.

40002867.author: पदार्थः
40002867.content: सुमन्त्रः Sumantra, करुणम् sorrowful words, श्रुत्वा having heard, दीनम् wretched, पार्थिवम् king, दृष्ट्वा च having seen, प्रगृहीताञ्जलिः with palms folded, तस्मात् देशात् from that place, किञ्चित् a little distance, अपाक्रमत् moved away.

40002867.author: Translation
40002867.content: Having heard the sorrowful words of the king and having seen his wretched state  Sumantra with palms folded moved away a little from the place.

40002868.author: पदार्थः
40002868.content: महीपतिः lord of the earth (the king), दैन्यात् due to the wretched conditon, स्वयम् personally, वक्तुम् to speak out, यदा when, न शशाक was not able, तदा then, मन्त्रज्ञा कैकेयी Kaikeyi, सुमन्त्रम् to Sumantra, प्रत्युवाच ह said in reply.

40002868.author: Translation
40002868.content: When the king himself in that wretched state was not able to speak to Sumantra, crafty Kaikeyi said to him in reply:

40002869.author: पदार्थः
40002869.content: सुमन्त्र O Sumantra, राजा king, रामहर्षसमुत्सुकः excited with joy in connection with Rama's coronation, रजनीम् entire night, प्रजागरपरिश्रान्तः weary with keeping awake all night, निद्रावशम् overpowered with sleep, उपेयिवान् is affected.

40002869.author: Translation
40002869.content: O Sumantra, excited with joy on account of the (proposed) installation of Rama, the king did not have a wink of sleep all night. He is weary and overpowered with sleep.

40002870.author: पदार्थः
40002870.content: तत् so, सूत O charioteer (Sumantra), त्वरितम् quickly, गच्छ go, यशस्विनम् illustrious, राजपुत्रम् prince, रामम् Rama, आनय bring, ते to you, भद्रम् gentle, अत्र in this matter, विचारणा hesitation, न कार्या need not be done.

40002870.author: Translation
40002870.content: So, O Sumantra quickly fetch the gentle, illustrious prince Rama. Let there be no hesitation in this matter.

40002871.author: पदार्थः
40002871.content: सः he, हृदयेन at heart, कल्याणम् auspicious event, मन्यमानः thinking, ननन्द च felt happy, राजशासनात् at the royal command, त्वरितः swiftly, सम्प्रीत्याः rejoiced, निर्जगाम च went away.

40002871.author: Translation
40002871.content: Thinking that an auspicious event will take place, he rejoiced at heart and in obedience to royal order, left at once.

40002872.author: पदार्थः
40002872.content: तया by her, चोदितः urged, सुमन्त्रः Sumantra, चिन्तयामास thought over, धर्मवित् a knower of righteousness, रामः Rama, व्यक्तम् definitely, अभिषेकार्थम् for installation, इह here, आयास्यति  he will come.

40002872.author: Translation
40002872.content: Urged by Kaikeyi, Sumantra thought 'Righteous Rama will definitely come here for the purpose of  installation'.

40002873.author: पदार्थः
40002873.content: सूतः the charioteer, इति in this way, मतिं कृत्वा having thought, महता हर्षेण with great delight, वृतः filled, महाबाहोः one with mighty arms, राघवस्य Rama's, दिदृक्षया  with an intention to see Rama, निर्जगाम came out.

40002873.author: Translation
40002873.content: So thought the charioteer and filled with great delight left (the inner apartment), eager to see the mightyarmed Rama.

40002874.author: पदार्थः
40002874.content: सुमन्त्रः Sumantra, सागरह्रदसङ्काशात् from a place which looked like deep waters of the sea, शुभात् auspicious, अन्तःपुरात् inner apartment, निष्क्रम्य having departed, अग्रतः ahead of him, जनसम्बाधम् thronged with people, द्वारम् gate, ददर्श saw.

40002874.author: Translation
40002874.content: Sumantra, departed from the auspcious inner apartment which looked like the deep waters of the sea and saw people thronging the gate.

40002875.author: पदार्थः
40002875.content: ततः then, सहसा immediately, पुरस्तात् forward, विनिर्गतः moving, द्वारगतः having reached  the gate, विलोकयन् seeing, द्वारम् gate, उपेत्य having approached, विष्ठितान् waiting, महीपतीन् kings, उपस्थितान् having arrived, महाधनान् wealthy people, (विविधान्) पौरान् citizens, ददर्श beheld.

40002875.author: Translation
40002875.content: Then Sumantra hastened towards the gate where he saw kings, wealthy people and citizens who had already arrived and waiting there. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे चतुर्दशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fourteenth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
